title: meshTerm host recipes, schema 1
description: Documentation of the format. scripts/validate.py (and the app's own HostRecipeDocument) are authoritative; they also check what JSON Schema cannot (placeholders, a literal sudo or su, coverage, serial rules).

serial.description: Monotonic. Every change takes the next serial; the app refuses a lower one, and the same one with other bytes.

idLike.description: meshTerm 2.3.2+ (older apps ignore it): the parents an unnamed derivative may inherit lines from through os-release ID_LIKE. Absent or empty: inheritance off. A distro named by any variant's ids (or the app's classifier) never inherits; otherwise ID_LIKE is walked in order: a token on this list is the parent, a family root off it (rhel, centos, suse, ...) stops with no parent, any other token is skipped; and an ids line naming it (without versions) applies between an id match and a version range.

packages.description: Package id (the app's HostPackage) -> family -> package name. A family with no entry needs nothing.

items.description: apt, dnf, yum, apk, pacman, zypper, macos, unknown, or any. Others are ignored by today's apps.

run.description: One line, printable ASCII. Placeholders: {{sudo}} (opens a command), {{user}}, {{packages}}, {{port}}, {{proto}}, {{group}} (only after -aG , -G  or addgroup {{user}} ), {{path}}. No literal sudo or su. A well-formed placeholder name this format does not know makes the variant unusable for today's apps (they use their bundled line), not the file invalid.

admin.description: Needs an administrator even without {{sudo}}. Default: whether it has {{sudo}}.

minSchema.description: The lowest format schema that can use this variant. An app reading an older schema treats the variant as unusable (its bundled line serves that intent and OS) instead of refusing the file.

ci.description: For scripts/run-recipes.py only; the app ignores it.

variant.description: Any other key marks a variant for a later app: today's apps keep the file and treat that variant as unusable (their bundled line serves that intent and OS when it would have been chosen).
